texts.zh:
[From.GetName]曾是圣地。


你们不明白你们犯下了多大的罪恶。


不过马上就会了。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] was a holy world.


You do not know the true extent of your sin.


Not yet.

label.en: Consider it as sprinkling the holy water.

texts.zh:
[From.GetAdjective]的轻微异动是一切的开端。我们收到了零星的情报，尽管之前仅在自己的空间内活动，他们的舰队现在已经开始向星系内遥远的众恒星系开动。异常先进的侦察舰开始探访那些古老的、被毁掉的星球，并对任何向他们打招呼或者回避的舰船发动攻击。现在，他们的目的和使命已经昭然若揭了。

我们现在知道[From.GetSpeciesName]已经整装待发，他们恢复了调查信标的数据链，并重新启用了那些在他们退缩到目前边境之时废弃的侦察哨站。情报显示，他们的意图是重新回到星系这张大棋盘上。

在[From.GetSpeciesName]空间，舰队正在集结，军队已经下达了征召令，那些古老的工厂再一次发出轰鸣声。几百年来第一次，[From.GetName]开始将他们的目光投注到边境线外广大的星系。

破败的船坞再一次得到修复与调整，一度沉寂的泰坦巨舰铸造厂重新上线。整个星系都在关注同一个问题：当这位一度沉睡的巨人决定恢复旧日荣光时，谁会成为第一个螳臂当车的宵小呢？
texts.en:
It began as a subtle shift in [From.GetAdjective] behavior. Scattered reports of their ships, once rarely seen outside their own space, now being spotted in remote systems all across the galaxy. Highly advanced scouting vessels visiting ancient, ruined worlds, refusing all hails and fleeing when attacked. Their purpose and mission unknown... until now.

We now know that the [From.GetSpeciesName] were preparing, recovering the databanks of survey beacons and automated scouting posts left behind when they retreated to their present borders. Gathering information for their return to the galactic stage.

In [From.GetSpeciesName] space, fleets are gathering, armies are being mustered and ancient factories roar to life. For the first time in an age, the [From.GetName] are looking outwards beyond their borders and towards the galaxy at large.

As their decaying shipyards are repaired and refitted and the dormant systems of Titan foundries come online, the rest of the galaxy is left with only one question - who will this once-sleeping giant target first in their quest to reclaim age-old glory lost?

label.zh: 巨人踏入了孩子们的游乐园……

texts.zh: 星海啊，我们终成一体。那些低等的碎片终于看清真相，重归我们的集群。我们将以[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]之名重临星海。能亲眼见证这一刻，是你们的福分。众生之巅，再踏群星。
texts.en: Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supreme lifeform once more strides the stars.

texts.zh:
星海啊，我们终成一体。那些低等的碎片终于看清真相，重归我们的集群。我们将以[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]之名重临星海。能亲眼见证这一刻，是你们的福分。众生之巅，再踏群星。

现在，你们的“星海共同体”将由我们接管。欢庆吧。
texts.en:
Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supreme lifeform once more strides the stars.

We will now be taking command of your 'Galactic Community'. Celebrations are warranted.

# 纳米方舟吞噬行星 / Arkship nanotech world-subsuming

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nomads_events_1.txt, common/situations/14_nomads_situations.txt, common/on_actions/02_component_on_actions.txt · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

方舟舰队对无主行星执行“吞噬”动作时，on_action 触发隐藏 nomads.4800（events/nomads_events_1.txt）：首次抵达则标记行星并开始情境 situation_arkship_nanotech_consume_planet；若取消后返回则清除宽限标记。

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

情境单阶段（进度0→1000，唯一态度“吞噬”），每月隐藏事件发放资源；方舟离开超过6个月则中止并清除标记；进度满 → 隐藏 nomads.4810 摧毁行星（可能触发被毁神圣世界的反应，见 planet_destruction.610）。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 完成 / 中止互斥。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 仅游牧帝国，目标为无主行星。

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：触发事件与情境定义（14_nomads_situations.txt）；行星被毁后的堕落帝国反应属其他故事。
